note: Starter leads only. Geography and profession tags guide discovery; verify current coverage, access and each vacancy. Company job boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee) are where most direct applications happen.

sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs
sources.access: Some browsing is public; login prompts vary.
sources.notes: Check employer originals and avoid duplicate cross-posts.

sources.name: Indeed
sources.access: Check the user's country site and current login requirements.
sources.notes: Research request redirected to Japan; do not infer the user's region from tool geolocation.

sources.name: Find a job
sources.access: Government entry page; follow the current service link.
sources.notes: Confirm the appropriate service for the user's UK nation.

sources.name: USAJOBS
sources.access: Public discovery; account and eligibility requirements vary by application.
sources.notes: Inspect eligibility and required resume/document rules for each announcement.

sources.name: Job Bank
sources.access: Government search portal; personalized features may require an account.
sources.notes: A posting does not establish work authorization or sponsorship.

sources.name: EURES
sources.access: EU portal; choose language and inspect relevant country routes.
sources.notes: Language selector reached; country vacancy search not tested.

sources.name: SEEK Australia
sources.access: Public search entry; check account needs for the selected action.
sources.notes: Separate regional services exist; research the correct one instead of treating Australia as universal coverage.

sources.name: Naukri
sources.access: Unverified; inspect in the user's browser if relevant.
sources.notes: Research tool could not open the homepage. This is a source lead, not a tested recommendation.

sources.name: Careers24
sources.access: Unverified; inspect current service and access.
sources.notes: Research tool could not open the homepage; investigate other local sources as well.

sources.name: Wellfound
sources.access: Public discovery entry; profile/application requirements vary.
sources.notes: Check location eligibility and the original employer listing.

sources.name: Welcome to the Jungle
sources.access: Select the appropriate market/language; verify coverage locally.
sources.notes: Homepage only; no profile creation or application was tested.

sources.name: Climatebase
sources.access: Public discovery entry; inspect current feature and account requirements.
sources.notes: Useful only when the person's interests align; do not inherit another candidate's sector preferences.

sources.name: Idealist
sources.access: Public discovery; inspect local coverage.
sources.notes: Separate paid employment from volunteering and internships.

sources.name: We Work Remotely
sources.access: Public search entry; inspect optional paid features and account requirements.
sources.notes: Remote does not necessarily mean work from any country or timezone.

sources.name: Teaching Vacancies
sources.access: Government public vacancy service.
sources.notes: Check required qualifications and the specific school's application route.

sources.name: NHS Jobs
sources.access: Unverified; inspect the current portal and account requirements.
sources.notes: Homepage research request failed. Check the appropriate national/employer portal.

sources.name: jobs.ac.uk
sources.access: Unverified; inspect current service.
sources.notes: Homepage research request failed; verify through university career sites as well.

sources.name: Greenhouse company job boards
sources.access: Public company boards; no account needed to browse or apply.
sources.notes: Search Google for site:job-boards.greenhouse.io (also boards.greenhouse.io) plus a job title and place, or run scripts/ats_search.py on target companies. Apply on the board itself: these are the employer's own forms. Root redirects to the vendor site.

sources.name: Lever company job boards
sources.access: Public company boards; no account needed. Some forms use hCaptcha.
sources.notes: Search Google for site:jobs.lever.co (EU: jobs.eu.lever.co) plus a job title and place, or run scripts/ats_search.py on target companies. Apply on the board itself: these are the employer's own forms. Root redirects to the vendor site.

sources.name: Ashby company job boards
sources.access: Public company boards; no account needed.
sources.notes: Search Google for site:jobs.ashbyhq.com plus a job title and place, or run scripts/ats_search.py on target companies. Apply on the board itself: these are the employer's own forms. The root has no index page; boards live at jobs.ashbyhq.com/company.

sources.name: Workable company job boards
sources.access: Public company boards; no account needed.
sources.notes: Search Google for site:apply.workable.com plus a job title and place, or run scripts/ats_search.py on target companies. Apply on the board itself: these are the employer's own forms.

sources.name: Recruitee company job boards
sources.access: Public company boards at company.recruitee.com; no account needed.
sources.notes: Search Google for site:recruitee.com plus a job title and place, or run scripts/ats_search.py on target companies. Apply on the board itself: these are the employer's own forms. Many companies show these boards on their own careers domain.

sources.name: Y Combinator Work at a Startup
sources.access: A free account is needed to see full listings and apply; the person creates it.
sources.notes: Automated check was refused (HTTP 406). Good for finding startups; many also list jobs on Ashby, Lever or Greenhouse.

sources.name: Hacker News: Who is hiring?
sources.access: Public monthly thread; no account needed to read.
sources.notes: A new thread appears on the first weekday of each month. Use it to find companies, then apply on their own job board.

sources.name: Built In
sources.access: Public search; account optional.
sources.notes: US tech hubs. Follow listings through to the employer's own application form.
